title: Expansion of Renovate to other dotfiles repos
description:
Centralize reusable policy

Once this repo’s config is stable:
    move the common Renovate policy into a shared preset repo/project
    keep only repo-specific customManagers and fileMatch in each repo
    have other repos extends the shared preset

Expand supported dependency surfaces intentionally

    Next likely candidates, but only when you explicitly want them managed:
    root configs/uv_tools.txt if converted to exact pins
    root npm globals files if converted to exact pins
    mise.toml only if you decide to manage exact tool versions instead of latest/lts
    other devcontainer repos/subtrees using the same comment+regex pattern

Broaden runner scope safely
    Because you may later span multiple GitLab groups:
    keep the runner on an explicit repo list first
    add only the specific repos you want managed
    avoid early broad autodiscovery
    if the current service-account identity becomes awkward across groups, migrate only the identity/token and keep the repo configs unchanged
